decisions.reason: A large bulk container close to the core range, with its own page, fits the firm's established business in a growing industry, and a large firm has the slack to carry it while results build, so there is no shortfall to trigger search.
The bulk-container valve complements the core container range and has its own page, so it is cheap to keep and gives no evident shortfall against aspirations.

The take-back service is only mentioned on the website, which makes its performance less certain, but it matches the firm's strategic move toward circular, service-based offerings, and the firm has enough slack to keep it for now.
